partners.mechanism_chain: BTK (HGNC:1199) —DISRUPTS→ B cell receptor signaling pathway (WP:WP469); B cell receptor signaling pathway (WP:WP469) —LEADS_TO→ Agammaglobulinemia (HP:0004311); MYH2 (HGNC:7483) —DISRUPTS→ cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Proximal muscle weakness (HP:0003701); cytoskeletal organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Ophthalmoplegia (HP:0000598). Loss-of-function mutations in BTK disrupt the B cell receptor signaling pathway, leading to agammaglobulinemia. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in MYH2 disrupt cytoskeletal organization, impacting muscle function and causing proximal myopathy and ophthalmoplegia.
